masterSecretPassword.description: masterSecretPassword: optional password for the PlcMasterSecretPassword prompt. Never logged.

rhTarget.description: rhTarget: empty for standard CPUs; primary or backup downloads to that CPU of an R/H system through RHDownloadProvider.DownloadToPrimary/DownloadToBackup (routes and prompts of RHDownloadProvider.Configuration).

allowHardwareDifferences.description: allowHardwareDifferences: true answers DifferentTargetConfiguration (differences between configured and target modules) with AcceptAll; false (default) refuses it and the download stops there.
